relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: Upon activation, it triggers caspase-1, leading to the release of pro-inflammatory cytokines, notably IL-1β and IL-18, which contribute to the sensitization of nociceptors and amplification of pain signals.

relationships.subject: caspase-1
relationships.evidence_quote: Upon activation by caspase-1 or caspase-5, GSDMD forms pores in the cell membrane, leading to cell lysis and the release of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as IL-1β and IL-18.

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine, previously known as VX-548 (Vertex) targets Nav1.8 and has received FDA priority review/approval for moderate-to-severe acute pain

key_findings: Review of non-opioid pain targets: Nav1.7/1.8/1.9, NLRP3/P2X7/GSDMD, kynurenine pathway, prostaglandins, bradykinin.
Nav1.8 inhibitor suzetrigine was FDA-approved for acute pain; several NLRP3 inhibitors face safety hurdles.
